annotations.title: What's hiring most in a place

description: Job Spotter. What's hiring most in a place. For "who's hiring in Leeds?", "what jobs are in demand in Austin?", "which companies are hiring nurses in Manchester?". Gives the roles advertised most and the employers with the most open jobs.

country.description: US or UK when the place exists in both, or a country by name.

what.description: Optional field to narrow it, for example "nurse" or "engineering".

where.description: A city, region, postcode or country, for example Birmingham, Austin, TX or remote.

name: jobspotter_whats_hiring
